--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_falsy_callbacks.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import pytest
+
+import attr
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("strict_bool", [False, True])
+def test_falsy_callbacks(slots, strict_bool):
+    events = []
+
+    class Convert:
+        def __bool__(self):
+            if strict_bool:
+                raise AssertionError("converter truth-tested")
+            return False
+
+        def __call__(self, value):
+            events.append(("convert", value))
+            return int(value)
+
+    class Validate:
+        def __bool__(self):
+            if strict_bool:
+                raise AssertionError("validator truth-tested")
+            return False
+
+        def __call__(self, instance, field, value):
+            events.append(("validate", field.name, value))
+            if value < 0:
+                raise ValueError("negative")
+
+    @attr.define(slots=slots)
+    class C:
+        x = attr.field(converter=Convert(), validator=Validate())
+
+    c = C("2")
+    assert c.x == 2
+    assert events == [("convert", "2"), ("validate", "x", 2)]
+    events.clear()
+    c.x = "3"
+    assert c.x == 3
+    assert events == [("convert", "3"), ("validate", "x", 3)]
+    events.clear()
+    attr.validate(c)
+    assert events == [("validate", "x", 3)]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="negative"):
+        c.x = "-1"
+    assert c.x == 3
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="negative"):
+        C("-1")
